title: I Built A 2.5D Action Adventure Cozy Exploration Game On Spawn Using AI
author: Wisdom-And-Wealth
selftext:
It's called The Chronicle 1: Ritalia

**It's a 100% FREE to play game you can start exploring right now INSIDE YOUR BROWSER**

*Honestly the marketing material and trailer needs a lot of work, but the game is fully functional and you could easily put in 40+ hours right now without getting stuck*

**60-90 hours of playtime, 200 quests, skill trainers, fishing, crafting system, skill wheel, writing the main quest myself currently**

**200+ NPCs, bounty boards, faction conflict, manually written lore, cool crafted armors and weapons, travelling traders, magical powers, ability skill tree, monsters, custom voiced NPCs, classes and much more**

It's built using Claude Opus 5.5 (Spawn's AI Agent called Savi runs on it)

You can actually build a solid game world and base with 1 prompt, and she also has a "lock in" function allowing you to get much higher capability and output once a day

In my experience building other games using Spawn, its largest issue is third person animations, its very bad at it, at least when someone who doesn't know how to properly explain a game animation to AI is prompting

However you can fix this using Mixamo animation packs by taking an fbx file from Mixamo and running it through a converter mod in Spawn so it can be used as a GLB file

Mods are abundant and address many fundamental issues

Assets, UI, and sound were generated using AI, I wrote all the lore for the game myself, the misc quests and side quests were mostly written by AI

The books & notes were made using AI but used my manually written lore as knowledge base

The main quest I'm writing myself

This took me a couple of weeks

  
**Game Description**

*Ritalia is ripe with political strife, and 4 factions vie for favor from the Kingdom's citizens, in order to regain full control of the kingdom*

*War is looming on the horizon, and its your job to explore the world in order to put end to it by siding with a faction of your choosing and helping them achieve victory*

*60-90 hours of gameplay in a 2.5D giant action adventure RPG with tons of exploration, over 5 regions to discover, countless towns to find, over 200 quests, all kinds of biomes with different creatures and enemies based on the region*

*Currently writing the main quest manually*

  
**If you're going to play it please do me a favor** \- Test it out, leave a positive review, but also tell me what made you click of and made you think "I'm bored" or "I want to do something else", *fixing that is key to building a good game and I need it for data*  


The game is a progression system, so you have to consistently play to get stronger, unlock more interest areas, progress the main quest, do cooler missions, get cooler gear etc.

ZERO Microtransactions, I'm only going to paywall the first DLC behind $5-$20 we'll see

**The game world you can explore is gigantic so don't worry about feeling like there isn't enough content to consume before you have to pay for more**



Make sure to create a free account to save your access

You can play it for FREE right now on Spawn here: [The Chronicle 1: Ritalia](https://www.spawn.co/@kapteinfedala/the-chronicle-i-ritalia)
